mapper.select: SELECT KEY1 EQP_G FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'QAX_DownSampling'

SELECT F.*,G.JURGE_RESULT,NVL(H.WIP,0) WIP FROM( SELECT TECH,PRODG1,PRODSPEC_ID,FLOW_ID,OPE_NO,MOVE,EQP_G,CLAIM_TIME_MAX,CLAIM_TIME_MIN,SR,MODULE,LAST_MAIN_OPE,STD_SR,UPLOAD_TIME FROM( SELECT D.*,NVL(E.STD_SR,1)STD_SR,E.UPDATE_TIME UPLOAD_TIME FROM( SELECT TECH, PRODG1,PRODSPEC_ID,OPE_NO,MOVE,EQP_G,CLAIM_TIME_MAX,CLAIM_TIME_MIN ,SR,MODULE,LAST_MAIN_OPE,FLOW_ID FROM( SELECT C.MFG_TECH TECH,A.PRODG1,A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.OPE_NO,A.MOVE,A.EQP_G,A.CLAIM_TIME_MAX,A.CLAIM_TIME_MIN,A.SR,A.MODULE,A.LAST_MAIN_OPE ,B.KEY2 MOVE_TARGET,D.FLOW_ID FROM A1MFG.DOWNSAMPLING_MOVE_HISTORY A LEFT JOIN PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY B ON B.FUNCTION_NAME = 'QAX_DownSampling' AND A.EQP_G = B.KEY1 LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO C ON A.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN ODS.WP_PRODUCT D ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = D.PRODSPEC_ID )WHERE MOVE >= MOVE_TARGET AND EQP_G = #{eqpG ,javaType=String,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )D LEFT JOIN A1MFG.DOWNSAMPLING_TARGET_SR E ON D.TECH = E.TECH AND D.OPE_NO = E.OPE_NO )WHERE SR > STD_SR )F LEFT JOIN A1MFG.DOWNSAMPLING_JURGE_HISTORY G ON F.PRODG1 =G.PRODG1 AND F.OPE_NO = G.OPE_NO AND F.UPLOAD_TIME = G.UPLOAD_STD_TIME LEFT JOIN( SELECT LINE, PRODG1,SUM(WAFER_QTY)WIP FROM( SELECT PRODG1,WAFER_QTY,LINE FROM PWEB.LOT_HOUR_TM AA WHERE UPPER(AA.LOT_INV_STATE) IN ('INBACKUPBANK', 'ONMOVEOUT', 'ONFLOOR') AND AA.LOT_FINISHED_STATE IS NULL AND AA.NENG_FLAG = '1' AND AA.PW_FLAG = '1' UNION ALL SELECT PRODG1,WAFER_QTY,LINE FROM PWEB.LOT_HOUR_TM@TO_A3PDW AA WHERE UPPER(AA.LOT_INV_STATE) IN ('INBACKUPBANK', 'ONMOVEOUT', 'ONFLOOR') AND AA.LOT_FINISHED_STATE IS NULL AND AA.NENG_FLAG = '1' AND AA.PW_FLAG = '1' )GROUP BY LINE, PRODG1 )H ON F.PRODG1 = H.PRODG1 WHERE G.JURGE_RESULT IS NULL ORDER BY NVL(H.WIP,0) DESC

SELECT C.*,D.SR ,CASE WHEN C.JURGE_RESULT='N' THEN '' WHEN D.SR<= C.STD_SR THEN 'Done' ELSE 'OnGoing' END SR_RESULT ,NVL(E.WIP,0) WIP FROM( SELECT A.PRODG1,B.CHIP_BODY ,A.PRODSPEC_ID,B.FLOW_ID ,A.OPE_NO,A.EQP_G,A.STD_SR,A.JURGE_RESULT,A.UPDATE_TIME,A.UPDATE_USER FROM( SELECT B.MFG_TECH TECH,A.* FROM( SELECT PRODG1,PRODSPEC_ID,OPE_NO,EQP_G,MODULE,CUR_SR,STD_SR,UPLOAD_STD_TIME,JURGE_RESULT,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER FROM A1MFG.DOWNSAMPLING_JURGE_HISTORY WHERE EQP_G = #{eqpG,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO B ON A.PRODG1 = B.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN A1MFG.DOWNSAMPLING_TARGET_SR C ON B.MFG_TECH = C.TECH AND A.OPE_NO = C.OPE_NO AND A.UPLOAD_STD_TIME = C.UPDATE_TIME)A LEFT JOIN ODS.WP_PRODUCT B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID )C LEFT JOIN( SELECT PRODG1,OPE_NO,MAX(SAMPLING_RATE)SR FROM( SELECT PRODG1,PRODSPEC_ID,OPE_NO,SAMPLING_RATE FROM PWEB.SAMPLING_RATE )GROUP BY PRODG1,OPE_NO )D ON C.PRODG1 = D.PRODG1 AND C.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO LEFT JOIN( SELECT LINE, PRODG1,SUM(WAFER_QTY)WIP FROM( SELECT PRODG1,WAFER_QTY,LINE FROM PWEB.LOT_HOUR_TM AA WHERE UPPER(AA.LOT_INV_STATE) IN ('INBACKUPBANK', 'ONMOVEOUT', 'ONFLOOR') AND AA.LOT_FINISHED_STATE IS NULL AND AA.NENG_FLAG = '1' AND AA.PW_FLAG = '1' UNION ALL SELECT PRODG1,WAFER_QTY,LINE FROM PWEB.LOT_HOUR_TM@TO_A3PDW AA WHERE UPPER(AA.LOT_INV_STATE) IN ('INBACKUPBANK', 'ONMOVEOUT', 'ONFLOOR') AND AA.LOT_FINISHED_STATE IS NULL AND AA.NENG_FLAG = '1' AND AA.PW_FLAG = '1' )GROUP BY LINE, PRODG1 )E ON C.PRODG1 = E.PRODG1 ORDER BY NVL(E.WIP,0) DESC

SELECT A.PRODG1,B.* FROM( SELECT PRODG1, PRODSPEC_ID FROM ODS.WP_PRODUCT WHERE PRODG1 = #{prodg1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )A JOIN( SELECT LOT_ID,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,MAINPD_ID,EQP_ID,NENG_FLAG,'N1A1'LOCATION,WAFER_QTY,CAST_ID,PROCESS_START_TIME,CLAIM_TIME FROM ODS.MOVE_HISTORY WHERE CLAIM_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{claimTimeMin},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{claimTimeMax},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPE_NO = #{opeNo} AND MOVE_FLAG =1 AND OPE_CATEGORY ='OperationComplete' AND NENG_FLAG =1 AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,3) <>'DYB' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,2)<>'YY' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,2)<>'YX' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,1)<>'B' UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,OPE_NO,PRODSPEC_ID,MAINPD_ID,EQP_ID,NENG_FLAG,'N1A1'LOCATION,WAFER_QTY,CAST_ID,PROCESS_START_TIME,CLAIM_TIME FROM PWEB.MOVE_HISTORY_A3 WHERE CLAIM_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{claimTimeMin},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{claimTimeMax},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPE_NO = #{opeNo} AND MOVE_FLAG =1 AND OPE_CATEGORY ='OperationComplete' AND NENG_FLAG =1 AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,3) <>'DYB' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,2)<>'YY' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,2)<>'YX' AND SUBSTR(MAINPD_ID,1,1)<>'B' )B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = B.PRODSPEC_ID
